How I understand shame versus guilt, it is on the receiving end where the distinction is made.

Shame = I violated society's values; they are shunning me but I still think that my behavior was justified according to my individual value system. Shame motivates to hide the behavior from those who disapprove, and to seek out people who do approve.

Guilt = I violated my own values (which may or may not line up with societies values). Society is shunning me for a behavior I did that I never would have done were I sticking to my own value system. Guilt motivates one to not repeat the behavior.

In both cases, society is having the same input, whether it's making fun, looks of disgust, or direct criticism. Whether it is processed as shame vs guilt depends on the fatty's own value system.
